verdict.rationale: Cooley GO's Delaware incorporation package explicitly generates the Certificate of Incorporation, Bylaws, Board Consents, and Restricted Stock Purchase Agreement (with 83(b) elections/vesting docs), matching the exact formation bundle described, and this is backed by the firm's documented emerging-companies practice scale (7,000+ startup clients, #1 VC-backed IPO counsel). Missing for 10: no independent hands-on account of actually engaging Cooley's attorneys for full-service incorporation (vs. self-serve document generator), only community mention of the Go resource generally.
